## Pull request checklist

- [ ] Tests pass locally (`pytest tests/ -q`)
- [ ] CLI smoke check if CLI changed (`ri-engine templates`)
- [ ] [CHANGELOG.md](../CHANGELOG.md) updated
- [ ] Docs updated for API/CLI/behavior changes
- [ ] Scope is focused; no unrelated refactors
